title: Compose Js Entity Class Refactor
description: Refactor compose/client/lib/js to only have one class per entity with exactly one method per field, one method for command, and one method for events for every field change. Align with compose/rs and graphql schema. Update downstream compose/react and tests.
summary: Legacy-free client refactor verified end-to-end. Tests: @compose/js 13/13, @compose/react 8/8, @compose/rs 53/53, @compose/sketchpad:build OK, nx @compose/sketchpad:test OK (deps). Runtime: fixed shell hooks — Navigation/LayoutWrapper use useDesignContext/useTypeContext/useWipKitOptional; kit collection hooks use useWipKitOptional in react logic. Sketchpad home loads on preview :4181 without context crashes.
